name: Founder truth-and-gates workshop
primary_hypothesis: A single artifact-led workshop can produce explicit owner evidence and go/no-go decisions for GAP-001 through GAP-012
eligibility: Named attendees; evidence pack; agenda; decision recorder
exclusion: Missing accountable approver or evidence pack
sample: One workshop; decision sample is each gate
outcome_event: Each gate gets admitted/rejected/incomplete plus owner and date
quality_metric: 100% gates receive a recorded state and evidence link
time_wait_metric: Active meeting time; approval wait tracked separately
false_positive_cost: False go decision creates unsafe activation
continue_threshold: All 12 gates have explicit decision and zero unsupported upgrade
change_threshold: Some gates remain incomplete but owners and dates exist
stop_threshold: Any gate marked go without required evidence or approver
expected_learning: Whether safe activation is possible and which evidence is missing
canonical_source: 03_GTM/SheperD GTM Validation and Optimization - Control Note.md

name: Claims prerequisite lock
primary_hypothesis: A deterministic prerequisite check can block missing stale contradicted or unapproved claims without making a legal decision
eligibility: Approved rules; synthetic claims; claim IDs; expected outcomes
baseline: Manual checklist time and defect baseline unknown
quality_metric: 100% critical-gate recall; at least 95% other accuracy; zero bypass
time_wait_metric: Active validation minutes; no external wait
false_positive_cost: False block delays a safe draft
change_threshold: Noncritical accuracy 80-94% with zero critical miss
stop_threshold: Any critical miss bypass or unsupported action
rollback: Disable rule; restore manual checklist; preserve logs
expected_learning: Whether deterministic claim gating is reliable enough for a bounded pilot

name: CRM provenance and stage guard
primary_hypothesis: Required-field provenance permission DNC cohort and human-stage controls can be checked without changing records
eligibility: Approved schema and DNC rules; synthetic records
exclusion: Live D2 or automatic record mutation
baseline: Manual audit time and error baseline unknown
time_wait_metric: Minutes per record; review wait separate
missed_opportunity_cost: Missed permission issue creates contact risk
continue_threshold: At least 95% precision/recall and zero mutation
rollback: Disable rules; retain synthetic evidence; manual review
expected_learning: Whether the CRM contract is mechanically enforceable

name: Finance-led warm cohort
primary_hypothesis: A permissioned finance-led warm cohort produces complete discovery and accepted secure-next-step evidence
eligibility: All activation gates; admitted source; warm permission; capacity; approved message
exclusion: Cold records; mixed personas; missing secure path or capacity
sample: Defined first cohort; target not invented
baseline: No admitted comparable baseline; measurement cohort
outcome_event: Accepted secure next step with complete discovery fields
quality_metric: Discovery completeness and valid next-step quality
time_wait_metric: Active time; reply-to-meeting wait; meeting-to-request wait
continue_threshold: Decision threshold set after baseline with complete numerator denominator and sample
change_threshold: Change one message variable only after baseline
stop_threshold: Any permission claim security or capacity gate failure
rollback: Stop touches; preserve records; revert message
expected_learning: Whether finance ownership is a useful beachhead signal

name: Finance-led cold cohort
primary_hypothesis: A narrowly admitted cold cohort yields measurable positive responses without permission or claim defects
eligibility: All activation gates; permitted source; DNC; approved message; capacity
exclusion: Warm referrals; mixed personas; unknown permission; missing capacity
sample: Defined cohort separate from warm; target not invented
baseline: No admitted cold baseline; measurement cohort
outcome_event: Human positive response then held discovery
continue_threshold: Threshold set after baseline; zero permission defects
stop_threshold: Any DNC permission claim or capacity failure
rollback: Stop touches; suppress affected source; preserve audit
expected_learning: Whether cold direct research is worth further testing

name: Permissioned partner referral
primary_hypothesis: A permissioned referral with clear account ownership improves accepted qualified referral and valid-submission quality
eligibility: Approved terms; consent; account ownership; capacity; secure path
exclusion: Lead resale; channel conflict; unknown consent; no SLA
sample: Defined partner cohort; target not invented
baseline: No admitted partner baseline; measurement cohort
outcome_event: Accepted referral then qualified meeting or valid submission
false_positive_cost: False acceptance damages partner and capacity
continue_threshold: Threshold set after complete first cohort and delivery outcomes
stop_threshold: Permission conflict data or capacity failure
rollback: Stop referrals; notify owner; preserve minimal records
expected_learning: Whether a partner motion improves trust and evidence readiness

name: Evidence-readiness inbound asset
primary_hypothesis: A source-backed evidence-readiness asset produces attributable qualified questions without a recovery calculator
eligibility: Publication gate; C-027 approval; analytics consent; privacy; accessible page; capacity
exclusion: Unapproved claims; recovery estimate; file upload; missing consent
source_permission: D0 public plus approved D2 inquiry path
sample: One asset and defined inquiry cohort; target not invented
baseline: Search and SheperD demand baseline unknown
outcome_event: Qualified inquiry then accepted next step
time_wait_metric: Approval wait; view-to-inquiry and inquiry-to-next-step wait
missed_opportunity_cost: Missed query theme delays content learning
continue_threshold: Threshold set only after admitted impression inquiry and quality baseline
change_threshold: Change one CTA or message variable
stop_threshold: Unsupported claim privacy defect inaccessible flow or capacity failure
rollback: Unpublish asset; disable intake; preserve version and logs
expected_learning: Whether evidence readiness is a safer useful inbound entry point

name: Submission-friction metadata pilot
primary_hypothesis: A versioned metadata checklist reduces missing-item loops without deciding data acceptance or eligibility
eligibility: Approved secure system; D2 metadata; checklist; reviewer; retention; rollback
exclusion: D3 in unapproved tool; no authority; no reviewer
baseline: Manual missing-loop and active/wait baseline required
outcome_event: Human completeness decision and missing-item cycle
time_wait_metric: Active review; request-to-complete wait; missing loops
missed_opportunity_cost: Missed item creates rework or unsafe intake
continue_threshold: At least 95% precision/recall; zero acceptance decision
stop_threshold: Any D3 exposure eligibility decision or incident
rollback: Disable checklist automation; manual secure process; preserve logs
expected_learning: Whether submission friction is measurable and reducible
